faq_heading: Homes near Strawberry Hill Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Strawberry Hill Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Strawberry Hill Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Strawberry Hill Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Strawberry Hill Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 75 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,268,000, townhomes $725,000, condos $476,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Strawberry Hill Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Strawberry Hill Elementary the median was 31 days on the market, closing at 97.1% of the list price, with 15% of sales above the list price for the 75 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Strawberry Hill Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Westerman Elementary (0.4 km west), Dr F D Sinclair Elementary (0.9 km east) and Jarvis Traditional Elementary (1.1 km west).

Strawberry Hill Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 7633 124 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Strawberry Hill Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Strawberry Hill Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Strawberry Hill Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Strawberry Hill Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 75 homes sold within 1 km of Strawberry Hill Elementary: 25 houses, 18 townhomes and 30 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $476,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Strawberry Hill Elementary

32 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Strawberry Hill Elementary in a straight line (22 elementary, 7 secondary, 3 other; 6 independent). The closest is Westerman Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Continuing Ed SD36 (Invergarry), 2.4 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Princess Margaret Secondary (1.4 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.3 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Chalmers Elementary (2.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Westerman Elementary (0.4 km west), Dr F D Sinclair Elementary (0.9 km east), Jarvis Traditional Elementary (1.1 km west), Cougar Creek Elementary (1.2 km south), Khalsa School Newton (1.3 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Westerman Elementary, 0.4 km west of Strawberry Hill Elementary.
